title: Agentic Process Automation
breadcrumb: Services > Agentic AI & Hyperautomation > Agentic Process Automation
meta_description: Agentic Process Automation from Dataq Software: scope, delivery pattern, platforms and committed outcomes.

blocks.x: Most agentic process automation engagements stall between the deck and the deployment. Ours are built to cross that gap: Agents that execute the work — tool-using, policy-bounded, and replayable for audit.. What follows is the working pattern, not the brochure.

Agentic process automation goes beyond RPA's screen-scraping: goal-directed agents read context, call APIs and tools, handle the 20% of variance that breaks scripts, and ask for human help exactly when policy says so. We map the process, define the tool surface (APIs, databases, document services, SaaS actions), write the policy envelope — what the agent may do alone, with approval, or never — and instrument every step for replay.

Production reliability comes from the unglamorous layers: deterministic tool contracts, sandboxed execution, evaluation suites replaying thousands of historical cases, and circuit breakers into human queues. Clients typically start with claims triage, KYC refresh, invoice exception handling, service-desk resolution and patient scheduling — processes with clear policy, high volume and expensive human fallback.

Programs of Agentic Process Automation run in Banking & Financial Services, Insurance & Risk, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Logistics & Supply Chain — always against one named number, always with the baseline signed first.
What ships, in the order it ships:

items: Process decomposition
task graphs with variance analysis to isolate agent-suitable scope
Tool & API contracts
typed, permissioned tool surfaces with sandbox execution
Policy envelope
autonomy tiers — solo, approval-required, forbidden — mapped to regulation
Replay & evaluation
historical-case replay suites gating every release
Human-in-the-loop design
escalation queues with context handoff and feedback capture
